name: Melon Soda
source:
The hero arrives to the town where the secret of forbidden pheromone juice "Melon Soda" is concealed. He will have to interrogate the girls in the town to get to the secret.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公来到一座小镇，据说禁忌的催情饮料“蜜瓜汽水”的秘密就藏在这里。为了查明真相，他必须询问镇上的女孩。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
